column4: Provides educational services: admission, enrollment, teaching, assessment and academic records.
Processes applications and admits applicants to programs.
Registers students in programs, courses and academic periods.
Delivers courses and supports students' learning.
Evaluates students and records their grades.
Keeps students' academic records and issues certificates and degrees.
Manages scholarships, grants and other financial aid for students.
